title: EU SAE Workbench
subtitle: Start an analysis and find your documents and results
introduction: Open this guide from the extracted package. It works offline and does not start R. Use the guided application for a new analysis.

groups.title: Using the Workbench
groups.description: Start with Guides 1, 2 and 3 in your preferred language. Additional reference documents are currently in English.

groups.title: Methods and interpretation
groups.description: Guidelines first, then the deviations note and optional technical details.

groups.title: Validation and limitations
groups.description: Current checks and statistical limitations, followed by clearly identified historical evidence.

groups.title: For maintainers
groups.description: Release and project records. These are not required for a normal analysis.

steps.title: Extract and prepare
steps.text: Extract the whole application ZIP. Install R 4.2 or later using a version approved by your organization. Keep the package folders together. The launcher installs missing R packages on first use, so allow an internet connection and time for setup. It reuses Pandoc or downloads a verified copy for HTML/Word reporting.

steps.title: Open the guided application
steps.text: Open Start_Here and use the launcher for your computer. Keep its terminal window open while working. Choose New model run, or Load saved configuration to continue with saved settings.

steps.title: Run the seven steps
steps.text: Choose your input files, check variable mappings and model settings, then run Check data readiness in Step 6. In Step 7, select Run model. AI report writing is optional and requires separate consent.

steps.title: Review and retain the run
steps.text: Use Open the report and Open the run folder when the run finishes. Review diagnostics, uncertainty and any AI advice before using the findings. Save a separate copy of the Word report before editing it.

launchers.action: Double-click; see launcher help for security prompts
Run in a terminal from the package folder

results.title: Current report
results.description: Open in a browser after a completed run. Keep outputs/data beside it for linked workbooks.

results.title: Editable report
results.description: Open in Word. Save a separate working copy before editing.

results.title: Consolidated results
results.description: Excel estimates, changes and diagnostics when the relevant steps complete.

results.title: Figures and diagnostic tables
results.description: Maps, plots and detailed diagnostics from the current run.

results.title: A previous run
results.description: Archived results; the parent run folder contains saved configuration and logs. Retain original inputs separately.

result_notice: outputs/ is reused by later runs. app_runs/ holds dated run folders. app_runs/_last_setup_files contains saved-setup support files and is not a run archive. A newly extracted package has no generated reports yet.

folders.purpose: Supplied Spain and synthetic examples. Your own approved inputs can be elsewhere.
Language folders containing Guides 1-3; PDF for reading, PPTX for editing.
Guidelines, methodology alignment, deviations and technical notes.
Current validation, limitations and historical QER evidence.
Release history and procedures; navigation source files.
Internal Word-report template; keep it with the application.
Current results and archived runs, respectively.
Application code, checks, builders and interface resources. No routine editing is needed.

troubleshooting: For startup problems, read Start_Here/README.md and startup_setup.log. If analysis completes without a report, inspect the run log for Pandoc or Word-conversion messages. The Guides and notes menu links to the same documentation catalogue.
